The subject is a named coarray, not an arbitrary constructor/value or an opaque image index.
The explicit specification declares corank independently of ordinary data rank.
The explicit specification supplies cobound information; final-star inquiries and valid image-index subsets retain9.6/16.9 meanings.
PDF122 lines18-19: zero or more nonfinal dimensions followed by the mandatory final-star dimension.
PDF122 line20: a nonallocatable coarray's declaration coarray-spec uses the explicit form; construct association keeps its additional defining rules.
Original continuation on physical PDF123, printed109, line1 gives one plus the upper-cobound count.
PDF123 line2; lower-cobound uses canonical specification-expr.

requirements.title: Explicit coshape ends with a final-star codimension
requirements.definition: Zero or more comma-terminated nonfinal dimensions may have optional lower and required upper cobounds. The final dimension has an optional lower cobound followed by star. Star is not an arbitrary integer upper cobound or a data-array extent.

pending.star-only: PENDING saved scalar and fixed-shape array declarations with[*]; one final dimension gives corank1.
pending.final-lower: PENDING[0:*] and[-1:*] admissions with otherwise eligible nonallocatable coarrays. Negative/zero lower cobounds are not forbidden merely by sign.
pending.nonfinal-list: PENDING[2,*], [0:1,5:*] and two nonfinal dimensions with independent lower/upper expressions. Keep all explicit upper>=lower conditions and rank+corank<=15.
pending.missing-star: PENDING complete saved INTEGER coarray declaration[2] lacking the required final star; repair only to[*] for the corank-one form. Match the explicit-coshape final-star grammar cause, not allocation status or generic recovery.
pending.misplaced-star: PENDING malformed[*,2], repaired only by restoring[2,*]. Keep the intended two codimensions and complete declaration context; disabled coarrays or unrelated syntax errors cannot corroborate the order condition.

requirements.oracle: Finite correct and malformed grammar/control forms without data access or numeric interpretation of star.
requirements.oracle_limitation: A syntax admission is not a runtime coshape or cross-image proof; actual image-dependent values remain source/oracle gated.

requirements.title: Nonallocatable coarray declarations require explicit coshape
requirements.definition: The coarray-spec of a nonallocatable coarray uses explicit-coshape syntax. Declared deferred-coshape lists are not an alternative merely because ordinary data shape is assumed or deferred elsewhere. Construct-associated inherited attributes require their own source interpretation.

pending.scalar-deferred-spec: PENDING nonallocatable saved INTEGER scalar x[:], repaired only to x[*]. No missing SAVE, pointer attribute or payload use.
pending.array-deferred-spec: PENDING ordinary saved INTEGER array x(2)[:,:], repaired only to explicit coshape[1,*]. Keep data rank, size, corank and nonallocatable role unchanged; a malformed mixed colon/star form is not this controlled grammar-class contrast.
pending.dummy-associate-source-use: PENDING nonallocatable dummy explicit coshapes versus ASSOCIATE/SELECT TYPE/SELECT RANK inherited corank/cobounds and CHANGE TEAM codimension-decl. Do not reject a legal associate merely because its declaration syntax is not an ordinary type-declaration coarray-spec, or call assumed data shape an assumed-coshape form.

requirements.oracle: Deferred-list to explicit-form report/control pairs and original construct/dummy boundaries.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No ALLOCATABLE/pointer addition, scalar-role switch or unsupported configuration substitutes for the selected condition.

requirements.title: Lower cobounds use specification expressions
requirements.definition: A lower-cobound is a specification-expr, retaining its scalar-INTEGER, restricted-expression, ordering and scope conditions.

pending.constant-lower: PENDING explicit nonfinal and final lower cobounds-1,0 and1 in otherwise valid saved/dummy contexts with matching upper constraints.
pending.nonconstant-lower: PENDING eligible nonoptional non-INTENT(OUT) dummy or host/use expression in subprogram/BLOCK/interface contexts under C829; no ordinary unrelated local initialized value falsely treated as a specification expression.
pending.expression-owner-source-use: PENDING canonical R1029/C1011 type/rank/restricted-expression contrasts and focused repairs, preserving original owners. Do not duplicate a lexical/constant test under a bare alias or assume a variable mention always makes an inquiry nonconstant.

requirements.oracle: Qualified expression admissions and source-use of the canonical specification-expression rule.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No new no-op or arbitrary scalar-kind diagnostic; no undefined/optional value is used by a valid control.

requirements.title: Nonfinal upper cobounds use specification expressions
requirements.definition: An upper-cobound appearing in explicit-coshape syntax is a specification-expr. It is distinct from the final star and its image/team-dependent inquiry interpretation.

pending.constant-upper: PENDING nonfinal upper bounds-1,0 and2 with suitable no-greater lower bounds, in eligible contexts. Sign alone is not the range restriction.
pending.nonconstant-upper: PENDING nonconstant eligible upper-cobound expressions in each C829 scope, with prior typing and complete dummy/host/use premises.
pending.expression-owner-source-use: PENDING canonical scalar-INTEGER/restricted-expression source relationships and focused repairs; no RANK expression proxy, unknown kind code or final-star integer substitution.

requirements.oracle: Exact expression-category and placement source evidence, not a sampled unallocated bound or a duplicated canonical wrapper.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Upper>=lower is a separate prose predicate, and nonconstant-scope eligibility is C829.

requirements.title: Nonconstant cobounds have three permitted source contexts
requirements.definition: A nonconstant lower or upper cobound occurs only in a subprogram, BLOCK construct or interface body. This does not make every expression valid there, or import the additional derived-type-definition context available for ordinary array bounds.

pending.module-nonconstant-lower: PENDING a module coarray using a previously typed use-associated INTEGER variable as nonfinal/final lower cobound, with legal constant upper values and module SAVE. Repair only the supplier declaration to PARAMETER so the expression becomes constant. Its primary is otherwise restricted; require the nonconstant-cobound/module-context cause, not unsupported coarrays.
pending.module-nonconstant-upper: PENDING analogous module nonfinal upper cobound from a use-associated INTEGER variable, repaired to a named constant in the supplier. Preserve lower<=upper, entity identity and valid declaration syntax.
pending.permitted-contexts: PENDING complete subprogram dummy-bound, BLOCK host-bound and interface-body bound contexts, with correct scalar-INTEGER/nonoptional/non-OUT premises and C826 lifetime. Admission is not evidence of a runtime capture effect.
pending.other-context-source-use: PENDING original-source comparison with main-program/derived-component contexts and constant-expression controls. Coarray components already require deferred coshape/ALLOCATABLE under C751, so an explicit component cobound is not a clean C829-only negative.

requirements.oracle: Finite scope/constancy report-control plans, with all independent expression, lifetime and numeric-range premises discharged.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No scope-moving shortcut or extra diagnostic policy; generic kind/constant words and wrong property/source recovery do not establish the selected C829 condition.

requirements.title: Explicit coshape corank includes the final-star dimension
requirements.definition: Corank is one plus the number of explicit upper-cobounds. The final star contributes one codimension, even when there are no nonfinal upper expressions.

pending.star-and-upper-count: PENDING configured runs of established scalar coarrays[*], [2,*] and[1,2,*], comparing permitted SIZE(LCOBOUND(...)) independently to1/2/3. No undefined payload or RANK-of-expression inquiry.
pending.ordinary-rank-independent: PENDING established rank-one and rank-two data coarrays with different coranks2/1, checking their independent known declaration counts. Actual coarray execution is required; single-image compilation is only syntax admission.

requirements.oracle: Independent small corank counts through allowed inquiries on established coarrays.
requirements.oracle_limitation: The two-image runtime gate is not satisfied by an old GNU14.4 calibration attributed to GNU16, nor by a fixed-rank destination.

requirements.title: Local nonconstant explicit cobounds are captured for the execution
requirements.definition: For a local explicit-coshape coarray of a subprogram or BLOCK with nonconstant cobounds, entry/execution evaluates the cobound expressions and establishes them for that execution. Later redefinition or undefinition of expression variables does not change them during it. Nonconstant cobounds alone do not make the object automatic under8.3.

pending.subprogram-capture: PENDING exact-two-image calls in matching order to a procedure with a saved scalar INTEGER coarray and nonoptional INTEGER INOUT dummy lower/upper/final-lower values0/1/5. Keep all data bounds/type parameters constant. Mutate source integers after entry and independently require LCOBOUND[0,5] and the applicable upper values in the unchanged team.
pending.block-capture: PENDING saved scalar coarray in a BLOCK using already defined host integer cobounds. Mutate them only in the executable body and compare captured properties to independent literals. No assumed lexical order among specification-expression evaluations and no implicit entry synchronization claim.
pending.fresh-executions: PENDING two matched procedure/BLOCK executions with different valid cobound inputs and explicit observation counts on every image. Each entry captures its own values; do not reuse the first descriptor forever or compare only two equally wrong outputs.
pending.source-undefinition: PENDING captured-cobound context followed by a complete INTENT(OUT) helper that leaves only the source integers undefined. Inquire the still-defined coarray properties without reading those integers, then restore them by literal assignment before reuse. No payload undefinition, memory poisoning or trap.

requirements.oracle: Defined property observations against independent per-entry literals, in unchanged teams and eligible SAVE/nonautomatic contexts. Any remote data observation additionally requires matched segment ordering and defined payload.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No C814-violating SAVE repair for nonconstant data shape/length, no speculative team-value arithmetic, and no compiler/profile mixing. These remain real run plans, not compile substitutes.

requirements.title: Explicit cobound values and omitted lower bounds determine the coshape
requirements.definition: Specified lower/upper values determine each explicit codimension's cobounds; an omitted lower cobound is one. The final-star and image-index interpretation additionally depends on the current/specified team and the intrinsic/image-selector rules, not a rectangular-size guess.

pending.default-and-explicit-lower: PENDING exact-two-image established coarrays[2,*] and[0:1,5:*], expecting lower vectors[1,1] and[0,5]. Inquire only available properties; data rank is independent.
pending.nonfinal-upper-values: PENDING explicit nonfinal upper values0/1/2 with valid lower values, comparing individual UCOBOUND DIM results to those literals. Do not use the final star as a literal upper expression or require arbitrary kind identifiers.
pending.partial-final-image-set: PENDING two-image scalar coarray[0:2,5:*]. Independently expect lower[0,5], upper[2,5], IMAGE_INDEX for[0,5]/[1,5] equal1/2 and for[2,5] equal0. The upper-corner tuple is within the rectangular cobounds but is not an actual image: never use it for remote access or treat0 as a valid target.
pending.defined-two-image-payload: PENDING actual two-image run: each image defines its own ordinary INTEGER payload to11 or22, both execute matching successful SYNC ALL, each reads only the known existing peer using its valid cosubscripts and checks the independent peer literal, then both synchronize before mutation/teardown. No undefined remote data, opaque field read, sleep or unsafe barrier assumption.
pending.team-association-source-use: PENDING original5.4.8/11.1.5/11.7.9/16.9 relation for a successful FORM TEAM and a CHANGE TEAM associating coarray with its own codimension-decl. TEAM_TYPE values come only from valid operations; child image indices without NEW_INDEX are processor dependent. Resolve retained declared cobounds versus UCOBOUND's current-team final value before cross-team oracles, rather than assuming an allocation-time image count forever.

requirements.oracle: Finite independent lower/upper/image-index expectations and synchronized defined payload checks. IMAGE_INDEX's zero result is a defined inquiry outcome, not permission to dereference a nonexistent image.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Multi-image/configuration and current-team establishment are genuine gates. The historical two-image GNU14.4/OpenCoarrays/MPICH witness remains its own context-only evidence, not a GNU16 runtime or proof for new team/coshape plans.

requirements.title: An explicit upper cobound is not below its lower cobound
requirements.source: 8.5.6.3 p4 final sentence, physical PDF123, lines13-14
requirements.definition: An explicit upper cobound is at least its corresponding lower cobound. Ordinary data arrays can have zero extent under different rules; that does not authorize an empty explicit codimension here.

pending.reversed-cobounds-source-contrast: PENDING otherwise-conforming saved scalar INTEGER coarray[2:1,*] as a source-only contrast, repaired only by changing the upper1 to2. This numeric predicate is prose, not a generic R811 grammar diagnostic or forced runtime trap.
pending.final-star-source-boundary: PENDING source-use of the optional final lower bound and implicit final-upper inquiry rule. Do not invent an explicit numeric last upper, a zero-image team or a global case-only bound formula without16.9/9.6 prerequisites.
pending.zero-data-extent-admission: PENDING ordinary rank-one zero-size INTEGER coarray with valid explicit coshape and a permitted local SIZE0 check, with no element read. Zero ordinary data extent is not zero corank or an empty codimension and supplies no cross-image payload evidence.

requirements.oracle: Source-only numeric restriction/repair and valid data-shape boundary contexts. Any future negative execution needs an independently authorized diagnostic basis.
requirements.oracle_limitation: No mandatory fatal/reporting policy for this unnumbered predicate, unsupported-configuration credit or undefined remote access.
